tagline.ja: カスタマーサポート受信箱 — 専用の PostgreSQL と Redis で動作します

notes: Sidekiq handles outgoing email, webhooks and automation. PostgreSQL needs pgvector for the schema; Redis holds the queue and installation-onboarding flag.
The Rails entrypoint does not migrate the schema; db:chatwoot_prepare runs before the web server and is idempotent on upgrades. A separate restartable one-shot service would loop forever.
Only Rails publishes on loopback. Sidekiq has its own fixed 1g memory ceiling rather than duplicating the user-selected web ceiling.
The panel claims the first administrator before a stranger can. ADMIN_PASSWORD is complex, stored and panel-only; it is never rendered in compose. ChatwootHub subscription is deliberately omitted.
